description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment to planning permission ref: DC/15/92295 (approved 23 March 2016) and associated Reserved Matters ref: DC/19/110414 (approved 20 March 2019), both as amended, in relation to Plot 6, for the comprehensive redevelopment of land bounded by Crown and New Baltic, Park and Bridge and Victoria Wharves, bounded by Grove Street, Dragoon Street and Evelyn Street, SE8. The application seeks to vary the wording of Condition 24 (Performance of the Energy Centre and Future Connection to an OSCHP Network) in relation to Plot 6 only. Specifically, it proposes to remove the requirement for the provision of conduits and/or ducting to facilitate a future connection to an Off-Site Combined Heat and Power (OSCHP) or district heat network, as Plot 6 is proposed to be delivered to Passivhaus standard.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
